cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Calm About the Impossible
cards.instruction: Remain perfectly calm around impossible events while becoming increasingly alarmed by ordinary details.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Your dragon can stay for tea. Please keep the biscuit crumbs off my carpet.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: His three heads breathe fire. Should I take him outside?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. He's fine here. Wait, three mouths? I need three napkins immediately.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He brought his own. They're paper.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Paper? At my good table? Fetch the linen before the neighbors see.

mechanism: A copies a dragon-calling gesture as etiquette, stays serene about fire and increases alarm about napkins and table manners.
confusable: D165 reverses sensible alarm priorities; D162 invents magical rules as expertise.
comparison: Host protecting table manners versus packing furniture and protecting polish.
seedUse: Keep B helpful paper-napkin solution as the next ordinary alarm, without arbitrary extra danger.
